title: OpenSea
description: Integration with OpenSea marketplace API for NFT collection data, listings, offers, events, and marketplace operations (buy, list, cancel, update)

opensea_get_collection.title: Get Collection
opensea_get_collection.description: Get detailed information about an NFT collection including name, description, image, social links, and contract addresses.

opensea_get_collection_stats.title: Get Collection Stats
opensea_get_collection_stats.description: Get collection statistics including floor price, total volume, total supply, number of owners, and average price.

opensea_get_nft.title: Get NFT
opensea_get_nft.description: Get detailed information about a specific NFT including metadata, traits, and rarity.

opensea_get_listings.title: Get Listings
opensea_get_listings.description: Get the best active listings for an NFT collection, sorted by price ascending.

opensea_get_offers.title: Get Offers
opensea_get_offers.description: Get offers for an NFT collection including offer price, bidder, and expiration.

opensea_get_events.title: Get Events
opensea_get_events.description: Get marketplace events for a collection including sales, listings, offers, transfers, and cancellations.

opensea_get_nfts_by_account.title: Get NFTs by Account
opensea_get_nfts_by_account.description: Get NFTs owned by an account on a specific blockchain.

opensea_create_listing.title: Create Listing
opensea_create_listing.description: Create a listing to sell an NFT on OpenSea.

opensea_buy_nft.title: Buy NFT
opensea_buy_nft.description: Buy an NFT by fulfilling a listing on OpenSea.

opensea_cancel_listing.title: Cancel Listing
opensea_cancel_listing.description: Cancel an existing NFT listing on OpenSea (off-chain cancellation, no gas required).

opensea_update_listing.title: Update Listing
opensea_update_listing.description: Update the price of an existing listing by canceling and relisting.
